text:
mina: Quick design sync 1: deciding where to put export & copy actions in the trace viewer. Thoughts on compact vs detailed layouts? Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/trace-ux-compact-vs-detailed

pat: My vote01 is compact inline actions for the list/drilldown (keeps row density), detailed header for single-trace pages.

devon: Agree. Also add a sticky export CTA when multiple traces are selected so users don't have to hunt in toolbars. Bulk download formats: JSON and CSV.

sam: Accessibility notes: Copy-to-clipboard must be local (no network) and announce via aria-live polite. If we use an icon-only button, supply aria-label="Copy correlation ID" and tooltip on hover/focus.

mina: Should we show full correlation IDs inline or truncated pill with hover/expand?

pat: Truncate in list, full in detail. Truncated pill should still expose full value to screen readers via aria-label and to keyboard users via a focusable reveal control.

devon: Analytics: track `trace.copy_id` (props: trace_id, page:list|detail), `trace.export_start` (props: selected_count, format, trigger:sticky|kebab).

sam: Keyboard flow: tab order -> title -> corr id (focusable) -> actions -> kebab. Kebab menu must support arrow navigation and return focus to trigger after close.

a11y-bot: Created tickets: UX-2101 (List corr-id pill), UX-2102 (Detail header id copy), UX-2103 (Sticky bulk export).

mina: Action items: mina update figma with both variants by Fri; pat build micro-interaction prototype for pill reveal on mobile by Mon; devon write analytics spec by Wed; sam add aria-live toast pattern and SR copy by Wed.

pat: Quick microcopy suggestion: visible label "Copy ID" on desktop, aria-label and SR copy "Copy correlation ID". Toast text: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard."

mina: Cool, closing thread. I'll attach prototypes when ready.
